'''Ghana Gleemort''' was a [[Gamorrean]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> [[Gamorrean Warrior|guard]] who worked for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Gleemort was present in the palace when several members of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] arrived to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], who was Jabba's captive. Gleemort carried a [[Vibro-ax]] and wore [[Color|brown]] [[armor]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
